Chapter 376 - 376 Slap Yourself; This Isn'T Over! (2)

Chapter 376 - 376 Slap Yourself; This Isn't Over! (2)

376 Slap Yourself; This Isn’t Over! (2)

At this moment, Xu Jingrou could not help but think back to the scene of Lin Fan playing the piano and the scene of him beating people up.

Quiet as a scholar, moving like a demon god!

No matter which it was, it was fascinating all the same!

Now, both sides had appeared on the same person!

At this moment, a crisp notification rang out in Lin Fan’s mind.

[You’ve triggered Charming Aura, an unforgettable memory!]

Lin Fan couldn’t help but look at Xu Jingrou.

[Appearance: 95]

[Favorability: 95]

“Ouch!”

At this moment, Feng Jiaqi, who had been slapped ten times by Lin Fan, started to scream.

His voice was like a stone thrown into a calm lake, causing ripples.

Everyone in the room finally reacted.

“CEO Feng, are you alright?” Wang Zhi asked.

“Alright?” Feng Jiaqi shouted. “Can’t you see that I’ve been beaten up like this? Hurry up and call security!”

“Alright, alright…” Wang Zhi hurriedly said.

Then, he quickly pressed the service button under the table and said, “There’s a fight here. Get the security guards here!”

Feng Jiaqi shouted at the top of his voice, “I’m Feng Jiaqi, the CEO of Hengxin Company. I know your manager, Zhao Feng. Tell him that I was beaten up!”

Soon, a respectful voice came from the speaker under the table. “Mr. Feng, please wait a moment. We’ll be right there.”

After saying that, the call ended.

After Feng Jiaqi received the waiter’s affirmation, he became extremely arrogant and said fiercely, “I’ve never been beaten like this before. You have guts! I hope you’ll have the same guts later!”

Lin Fan glanced at Feng Jiaqi and said, “Looks like you haven’t been beaten up enough!”

He turned around and slapped Feng Jiaqi again.

Everyone did not expect that Lin Fan would dare to hit someone. They were all shocked.

Feng Jiaqi did not dare to say anything else.

Xu Jingrou, who had been in a state of infatuation, finally reacted.

“What should we do now?” she asked in a panic. “Lin Fan, why don’t you leave?”

Xu Jingrou knew that Lin Fan was a student.

Feng Jiaqi’s Hengxin Company was going to be listed soon. He was definitely a rich and powerful big shot.

Now that Lin Fan had beaten Feng Jiaqi, he would definitely suffer.

“Now you know how to be afraid?” Feng Jiaqi endured the pain and said. “Well, it’s too late!”

Lin Fan’s cold gaze made Feng Jiaqi shiver and shut his mouth immediately.

Then, Lin Fan stroked Xu Jingrou and said, “Don’t worry.”

At this moment, the door to Room 6 was suddenly pushed open.

Then, a large group of security guards and a middle-aged man in a white shirt strode in.

When Feng Jiaqi saw who it was, he shouted excitedly, “Manager Zhao, you’re finally here!”

Zhao Feng sized up Feng Jiaqi and could not help but ask in puzzlement, “And you are?”

Earlier, Feng Jiaqi did not lie. He did know Zhao Feng.

However, at this moment, Feng Jiaqi’s entire face had been beaten into a pig’s head.

How could Zhao Feng recognize him?

“Manager Zhao, I’m Feng Jiaqi from Hengxin!”

“CEO Feng? Why are you like this?” Zhao Feng said in surprise.

Feng Jiaqi pointed at Lin Fan and said, “It’s him. He hit me! Manager Zhao, you must help me!”

“Don’t worry, CEO Feng!” Zhao Feng immediately said.

When he turned around and looked at Lin Fan, he was about to say something.

At this moment, hurried footsteps sounded from outside the corridor.

Qiu Kai quickly walked in and said anxiously, “Mr. Lin, are you alright?”

Even though Qiu Kai felt that he did not have the right to toast Lin Fan, he remained standing far away where he kept an eye on the door of Room 6.

Qiu Kai’s thoughts were simple.

In a while, when Lin Fan was done eating, he would walk over and create a scene where he happened to meet him.

He wanted to show his face in front of Lin Fan and leave a good impression.

It would definitely be of great benefit to his future.

However…

Qiu Kai had only been thinking about it for a while when a large group of security guards rushed into the private room.

He understood that something had happened in the room.

Therefore, Qiu Kai did not hesitate at all and ran over quickly.

Lin Fan looked at Qiu Kai’s anxious expression and nodded in his heart. ‘Qiu Kai is not bad!’

“I’m fine. It’s just that this person called Feng Jiaqi wanted to force my girlfriend to drink and even wanted to hit her, so I taught him a lesson.”

Forcing Lin Fan’s girlfriend to drink?

He even wanted to hit Lin Fan’s girlfriend?

How dare he?

“Motherf*cker!”

Qiu Kai was furious and kicked Feng Jiaqi.

Feng Jiaqi took a few steps back and fell to the ground, curled up into a shrimp ball.

Attacking someone in front of so many security guards?

Everyone was dumbfounded.

The security guards could not help but pull out the rubber batons at their waists.

When Zhao Feng saw this, a drop of cold sweat immediately appeared on his forehead. He shouted at the security guards, “Put them down, all of you!”

When the security guards heard this, their faces revealed a hint of confusion.

However, they still put down the rubber batons as they were told.

Then, Zhao Feng bowed and said in an extremely respectful tone, “Hello, Young Master Qiu.”

Although the Qiu family could not compare to the Zhou family, a woman from the Qiu family had married into the Zhou family.

This was enough to prove that the Qiu family was extraordinary.

Qiu Kai was a direct descendant of the Qiu family!

Of course, more importantly, Qiu Kai was the nephew of the Zhou family!

Qiu Kai did not pay any attention to Zhao Feng and continued to punch and kick Feng Jiaqi.

In the blink of an eye…

Feng Jiaqi was about to faint from the beating. Lin Fan said, “Alright.”

When Qiu Kai heard this, he stopped and bowed again. “Yes, Mr. Lin.”

Lin Fan gently stroked Xu Jingrou who was in a daze.

Then, he said, “I’ll leave this to you. Is there a problem?”

“No problem! Mr. Lin, don’t worry. Leave it to me. I’ll definitely give him a severe punishment!” Qiu Kai said.

The meaning of his words was very clear. The beating just now could not be considered a severe punishment.

Lin Fan said casually, “Do as you see fit.”

“Jingrou, let’s go.”

“Ah… Ah… Alright.” Xu Jingrou said.

Qiu Kai quickly went to the door of the private room to send Lin Fan off.

After Lin Fan and Xu Jingrou left, Qiu Kai turned around and returned to the private room. He looked at Feng Jiaqi, who was lying on the floor like a dead man.

Then, his gaze landed on Zhao Feng, and he said in a deep voice, “Zhao Feng, you weren’t rude to Mr. Lin just now, right?”

At this moment, how could Zhao Feng not understand that Lin Fan’s identity was extremely terrifying? He hurriedly said, “No, no, no, no.”

When Qiu Kai heard this, his expression softened.

Zhao Feng reminded Qiu Kai, “This person is the CEO of Hengxin Company, Feng Jiaqi. He’s from the Feng family.”

The Feng family was considered a small family in the capital.

Of course, the Feng family could not be compared to the Qiu family.

However, if the Qiu family wanted to completely ignore the Feng family, it was impossible.

“The Feng family?” Qiu Kai snorted. “Old Master Zhou will personally investigate this matter!”

Hiss!

When Zhao Fengyan heard this, he sucked in a breath of cold air, and his eyes widened.

Perhaps there were many old people with the surname Zhou in the capital.

However, the old master of the Zhou family that Qiu Kai mentioned could obviously only be one person—the old master of the Zhou family, Zhou Guotao!

That was Old Master Zhou, who had single-handedly founded a top-notch family in Hua Nation!

He… would personally investigate this matter?

Who was that young man called Lin Fan?

hen, Zhao Feng suddenly remembered what he was going to say to Lin Fan and could not help but shiver.

It was alright…

It was alright… His mouth was slow, and Qiu Kai came before he could say anything.

Otherwise, it would definitely be an extremely terrifying matter.

Then, Zhao Feng’s gaze fell on Feng Jiaqi, who was lying on the ground. He was furious.

This fellow… He had almost offended Lin Fan because of him!

How despicable!
